strongs_1890.strongs_def: probably akin to G3534 (νῖκος)); fond of strife, i.e. disputatious

occurrences.bsb: If anyone is inclined to dispute this, we have no other practice, nor do the churches of God.
occurrences.kjv: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.
